source_versions.empirical_execution: stdlib BM25, exact inner-product hashed-trigram search, typed graph walks, and RRF on a 34-document constructed pool; FAISS/NumPy/MiniLM unavailable under sealed PATH

criteria.criterion: Relevance recall/ranking and admitted-premise yield have independent label provenance and full corpus/query counts.
criteria.explanation: The frozen pool has 34 documents and 12 queries. Relevance uses citation_and_controlling_source/v1 over the full 34x12=408 pairs (35 positives; unlisted pairs are implicit negatives in compact qrels). Admitted-premise usefulness uses explicit_dependency_or_admission/v1 over the same 408 pairs (28 positives). The positive sets differ. Import-overlap proxy occupies a third label_task on the 5 premise goals x 34 documents (170 pairs) and is never used as the primary usefulness gold. Every retrieval and premise-selection observation row reports corpus_n_documents and query_n.

criteria.criterion: Vector route is executed against real backend/dependencies; mock vectors or declared-only CLI modes cannot count as measured retrieval.
criteria.explanation: Under sealed PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin and a fresh HOME, faiss is absent and NumPy C-extensions fail because libblas.so.3 is missing. The measured vector route is stdlib-exact-inner-product/v1: L2-normalized signed character-trigram hashes actually added to a brute-force IndexFlatIP-equivalent and searched by inner product. Vector scores vary across documents (not constant mock ranks). The GraphRAG thin-client vector subcommand is not dispatched. FAISS-store MockFaiss is inspected, not imported. MiniLM is unavailable in sealed HOME; the encoder is disclosed as signed-char-trigram-hash/v1, not a semantic teacher.

criteria.criterion: Hand-authored selector weights and proxy labels are disclosed; any unavailable conditions narrow only their associated claims.
criteria.explanation: Deterministic baseline weights (0.45/0.20/0.20/0.15) and graph-selector weights (symbol_score 3.2, bias -1.6, digest sha256:ad48f4b45a454bc41b63bef17ed7b4c1695b8c21ab118c1ec16766f21a14aa75) are recorded as hand-authored with trained=false and no independent train/split. Proxy import-overlap recall is a separate metric (0.788889 at k=5) beside usefulness recall (0.96/0.92). Unavailable FAISS, MiniLM, trained selectors, and AF-004 natural source bodies (1913 final-test units, AF-005 gold pending) are listed with claim_narrowing that they do not fill Table 13 natural cells or support semantic-encoder/FAISS-library claims. Combined RRF is an untrained fusion.

commands.execution_kind: sealed-PATH lexical/vector/graph/RRF retrieval and premise-selection measurement
independent-label, full-count, real-vector, and disclosure checks

limitations: FAISS, NumPy (libblas.so.3), torch, transformers, and MiniLM are unavailable in the sealed validation environment; no FAISS-library or neural-encoder retrieval quality is claimed.
The executed vector encoder is signed hashed character trigrams, not sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2.

The evaluation pool is constructed_control (14 policy/code/trace/frame documents plus the 20-theorem Hammer fixture), not the AF-004 natural legal corpus whose bodies remain owner-only and whose AF-005 gold is pending.
Relevance and usefulness labels are constructed protocols authored before scoring, not independent human adjudication.
Theorem usefulness labels are schematic lemma maps, not mined Mathlib proof dependencies or native checker admissions.
Graph-selector and deterministic baseline weights are hand-authored; no trained selector or independent train/split artifact exists.
Import-overlap proxy recall is diagnostic only and is not proof-premise recall.
Combined RRF is an untrained rank fusion, not a learned fusion policy.
Constructed_control metrics do not fill Table 13 natural held-out cells.
This receipt is provenance validation, not independent scientific replication.
completion_scope: Matched-budget lexical BM25, exact inner-product hashed-trigram, graph-walk, and untrained RRF measurements plus deterministic and hand-authored graph premise selectors on a frozen 34-document/12-query constructed pool with independent relevance and usefulness labels; natural-corpus, FAISS/MiniLM, and trained-selector claims remain unavailable.
